title: 跨时区交接时，怎样把背景和下一步写完整
topic: 读 GitHub 工程沟通指南，练习写下决策背景、当前进度、未完成事项和接手动作。

source.title: How GitHub Engineering communicates
source.section: Be asynchronous first; Write things down
source.type: GitHub 工程团队公开版沟通指南
paragraphs: Whenever possible, prefer issues and chat messages to “just in time” communications (like a last-minute meeting), reserving more synchronous methods as points of escalation only when the urgency or complexity of the communication requires it.

If we want to be asynchronous first as a globally distributed organization, it’s essential that we write things down—especially the “why” and the “how” of decisions—in the most durable, searchable, and discoverable medium possible.

Let others opt in to context and subscribe to updates. Make it easy for others to understand what’s going on, and be sure to add a TL;DR summary at the beginning of any communication to ensure your main points get across.
translations: 尽可能优先使用 issue 和聊天消息，而非临时会议；只有当紧急程度或问题复杂度需要时，才升级为同步沟通。
对全球分布式组织而言，异步协作需要把事情写下来，尤其记录决策的原因和做法，并放在持久、可搜索、易发现的位置。
让别人可以按需了解背景并订阅更新。让进展容易理解，并在沟通开头加上 TL;DR 摘要，突出要点。
fullTextParagraphs: Working asynchronously has a number of benefits. Knowledge workers are most productive when they have large blocks of uninterrupted time. A two-hour block of time is not fungible with four 30-minute blocks. Unlike working on an assembly line, when knowledge work is accidentally or intentionally interrupted, there’s a significant context-switching cost to get back to where you were.

Whenever possible, prefer issues and chat messages to “just in time” communications (like a last-minute meeting), reserving more synchronous methods as points of escalation only when the urgency or complexity of the communication requires it.

If we want to be asynchronous first as a globally distributed organization, it’s essential that we write things down—especially the “why” and the “how” of decisions—in the most durable, searchable, and discoverable medium possible.
We prefer workflows that don’t require anyone to be in a certain place at a certain time working on a certain thing in order to collaborate with one another.

Beyond supporting our asynchronous and distributed workflows, writing things down serves as a message in a bottle to our future selves and our future peers, recording what decisions were made and why.

Let others opt in to context and subscribe to updates. Make it easy for others to understand what’s going on, and be sure to add a TL;DR summary at the beginning of any communication to ensure your main points get across.
verifiedFacts: GitHub 的公开材料介绍了本课练习的工作做法。
练习场景为虚构训练，不代表公司真实员工对话。

scenario.title: GitHub工作场景练习（虚构）
english: A teammate in another time zone will continue the launch checklist while you are offline. The decision to hold one item is made, but the reason, missing information, and next owner are not documented.
Write a handoff note with the decision context, what is done, what is still missing, and the next action.
chinese: 另一时区的同事会在你离线时接着处理上线清单。团队决定暂缓其中一项，但还没记录原因、缺少的信息和下一位负责人。
写一条交接说明，包含决定背景、已完成事项、缺少的信息和下一步。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请写一条跨时区交接消息：记录暂停发送客户通知的原因、已经核对的版本、尚缺的法务确认，并请同事收到确认后更新状态。
firstAttempt.sample: We’re holding the customer notice until Legal confirms the wording. I checked the latest draft and added the open question to the issue. Please update the status once Legal confirms; the decision and context are documented here.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先给出关键背景和动作，再说明责任人与时间。

structure.original: Let others opt in to context and subscribe to updates.
analysis: 用 opt in to context 表示主动选择了解背景，用 add a summary 让信息可快速浏览。
迁移时补上新的工作对象、负责人和明确期限。
structure.transfer: Let others opt in to context by linking the decision note. Add a short summary of what is done, what is blocked, and who owns the next step.

rewrite.bad: I’m off now. Ask someone else about the launch.
rewrite.good: We’re holding the customer notice until Legal confirms the wording. I checked the latest draft and added the open question to the issue. Please update the status once Legal confirms.
rewrite.translation: 法务确认措辞前，我们先暂缓客户通知。我检查了最新草稿，也把待确认问题记在 issue 里。法务确认后请更新状态。
rewrite.pattern: State the context, propose a clear action, and name the owner or deadline.
